## Meaning

This monitor fired because a fixed threshold was crossed.

Query:

```
max(last_6h):max:acme.vmware.snapshot_age_days{__SCOPE__} by {vsphere_cluster,vm_name} > 7
```

**Why this threshold is a fixed number.** Seven days is the operational policy limit; aged snapshots consume datastore capacity and slow consolidation unpredictably.

## Impact

Observability or configuration hygiene is degraded. No direct customer impact, but our ability to see or govern the estate is reduced.

Error budget: this condition is associated with `slo-vmware-cluster-availability`. If the alert is sustained, expect burn-rate alerts on that objective to follow.

## Automation

Workflow `auto-capacity-ticket` (fully automatic) runs when triggered.

Actions: `attach_forecast_chart`, `create_servicenow_task`, `assign_to_owner`.
